newsitem.title: UK: Algeria to sell most March oil at 79 cts over Brent.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to sell most March oil at 79 cts over Brent.

text.p: Algeria has agreed contract prices for March sales of Saharan Blend crude oil at 79 and 80 cents above Dated Brent, an official at the state oil company Sonatrach said on Wednesday.
"The majority has signed at 79 cents over and some at 80 cents," he said.
This corrects term contract holders who said on Tuesday they believed some contracts had been signed at Dated Brent +78 cents.
In February prices had been 78 and 79 cents above, an increase from the 73 and 74 cents set for January barrels.
Meanwhile, negotiations for March Syrian crude prices continued with traders and state oil company Sytrol ideas wide apart.
Some contract holders said their bids were as low as 80 cents below Dated Brent while others were around 15-20 cents above this.
Sytrol is holding out around 40 to 45 cents under Dated Brent, down from 27 cents under in February.
Traders said they had paid in excess of the market level in January and February and were holding out for a market level in March.
"Nobody is asking for something below market but with Urals around (Dated Brent) minus $1.05 (a barrel) Syrian (light) needs to be at least (dated Brent) minus 70 cents," one said.
One refiner was heard to have bought a Syrian Light cargo on the water in mid February at Dated Brent -$1.00 a barrel.

"We paid 15 cents over (the market) in January and 30 (cents) over the market in February. I want to pay a dollar (under dated Brent) this time. We are bidding minus 80 cents," another contract holder said.
